item.description:
A compatibility release for macOS 27, plus groundwork for tracking down the occasional silent quit.

  • The month picker works on macOS 27 again. On macOS 27 the toolbar’s month selector came up blank. The app itself was fine; the fix is that Pits is now built against the macOS 27 SDK, which is what the new OS needs to draw the picker. Releases are built on GitHub’s Xcode 27 runner from here on.
  • Silent quits are now logged. Pits occasionally disappeared from the menu bar and Dock without a crash report. Every quit trigger now leaves a note in the unified log (a termination signal, a quit Apple Event, or neither), and removing the status item from the menu bar hides the icon instead of ending the app. If Pits vanishes, the log will say why.
  • Sparkle updated to 2.10.0. Picks up the updater’s macOS 27 fixes.
